propositions: Multiple tracker projects against a single codebase or repos cannot use the bridge because JiraConfig.project is hardcoded to a single scalar value, the JQL fetcher fails on empty projects, and the applier aborts on cross-project mutations.

The store must own the project set via a .bridge_state/projects.json mapping to prevent each repo's fetched project subset from appearing as remote deletions when diffing against a shared prev_snapshot.json.

Each ticket records its target project (tri-state: absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit key=sync there) and the repos it belongs to, with per-ticket project immutable after binding creation.

Multi-project inbound fetch must fan-out over the configured project set and merge enrichment data (parent/comment/issuelink maps) from all projects into a single snapshot, with per-project truncation ceilings.
An absent project field resolves to the legacy Backend.project default via an idempotent ensure unit that seeds the mapping, writing no events to preserve pre-feature stores.

Stores with >1 project in the mapping receive the multi-project-bridge capability stamp in required_capabilities; older binaries lacking this capability refuse writes to genuinely multi-project stores, preventing duplicate issues.
